wages: Covers employees only. The self-employed and informal sector are not included, and they are a large share of Malaysian workers.
Medians are composition-sensitive: the median of the employee population shifts when the mix of employees changes, independently of anyone's pay.
2020 reflects the pandemic shock to the employee population, not a normal year.
income: HIES is a survey with irregular gaps between years. Lines between survey points are not drawn.
Household income is not the same measure as individual wages; household size and the number of earners both move over time.
caveats.pricecatcher: PriceCatcher is a price-surveillance dataset. DOSM states explicitly that inflation analysis should use CPI, not this data. Figures here are for item-level illustration only and never feed an inflation number.
